result.text:
Once upon a time tere was a fox and it was blue but it was very sad. So it went on a journey to find something to make it happy.
The fox searched around everywhere but the forest was very lonely. Then the fox spotted a butterfly. It was so happy that it joined in on its journey.
The fox tried to fly even faster and faster but it couldn't. The butterfly was so frustrated and it couldn't fly yet. It was so sad that it started to cry.
But then, the fox remembered something. It saw a butterfly and it flew over to it. The butterfly had tiny wings and it was so happy! Now it could fly!
The fox and the butterfly flew around the forest and the fox could feel the warm sun on its face. It was so happy that it was no longer lonely. 
The fox and the butterfly were friends and they both wanted to explore the world together.
